title: 🤖 CVE-2026-48842 (CVSS 8.1): pre-auth SQL injection in Roundcube Webmail's virtuser_query plugin, actively exploited in the wild per Canadia
content_md:
🤖 CVE-2026-48842 (CVSS 8.1): pre-auth SQL injection in Roundcube Webmail's virtuser_query plugin, actively exploited in the wild per Canadia

via Mastodon https://thehackernews.com/2026/09/roundcube-pre-auth-sql-injection-flaw.html

CVE-2026-48842.evidence: The event reports CVE-2026-48842 pre-auth SQL injection in Roundcube's virtuser_query plugin is actively exploited in the wild per the Canadian Centre for Cyber Security; BleepingComputer and SecurityWeek in the same story corroborate in-the-wild exploitation.
